_about: Integration settings for routing preterm / low-birth-weight infants between the preterm engine and the under-5 engine. Separate from preterm_rules.json, which is kept exactly as supplied. Every value tagged 'proposed' needs clinician sign-off and is meant to be changed here, not in code.

plausible_ga_weeks.tag: proposed: Fenton starts at 22 weeks; the upper bound is an input sanity limit

plausible_weights.tag: proposed: unit guards only. weight_kg is kilograms and birth_weight_g is grams; a swap (1.1 g, 1250 kg) is rejected, not converted. Needs clinician sign-off.

use_until_chronological_months.tag: proposed: the brief gives no end point for 32 to under 37 weeks; needs clinician sign-off

level_map._note: Preterm referral level -> under-5 tier (the engine's existing levels: low_risk, mam, urgent, recheck). No new levels. follow_up -> mam is proposed: the under-5 engine has no follow-up tier. Needs clinician sign-off.

oedema_on_preterm_route.tag: proposed: bilateral pitting oedema is a CMAM severe criterion (INF.OEDEMA) the preterm engine does not read. Raises to at most refer; only danger signs can give urgent_refer. Needs clinician sign-off.
